title: Western
story: Saddle up for a sunny ride across the open range.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A wide-brim cowboy hat with a tall creased crown and a curled brim, with a band around the crown.
cards.hero_colors: tan felt, brown band, small red feather tucked in the band

cards.name: Cowboy Boot
cards.subject: A tall leather cowboy boot with a pointed toe, an angled heel, a stitched shaft and a spur at the heel.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather, cream stitching, small gold spur

cards.name: Sheriff Star
cards.subject: A five-point star badge with a ball on each tip and a round disc in the center.
cards.hero_colors: shiny silver, small red center disc

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A leather horse saddle with a raised front horn, a curved seat, two side stirrups and a cinch strap.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather, silver stirrups, small turquoise strap

cards.name: Horseshoe

cards.hero_colors: dark grey iron, small brown rusty nails

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A coiled rope with an open loop at one end and a knot where the loop meets the rope.
cards.hero_colors: tan rope, small red wrap on the knot

cards.name: Coffee Pot

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
